plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("marketing science" OR "quantitative marketing" OR "marketing analytics") AND (pricing OR promotion OR advertising OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Captures broad, evidence-oriented marketing research likely to include pricing, promotion, ad, and conversion studies without drifting into media theory.

queries.query: ("price ending" OR "charm pricing" OR ".99 pricing" OR "psychological pricing") AND (pricing OR purchase OR demand OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Targets experimental and observational studies on whether non-round prices affect demand, purchase likelihood, or conversion.

queries.query: (discount OR discounts OR promotion OR promotions OR coupon OR coupons) AND (brand dilution OR "brand equity" OR reference price OR willingness-to-pay)
queries.rationale: Finds work on when promotions lift sales versus erode perceived value, reference prices, or long-run willingness to pay.

queries.query: (advertising OR advertisement OR "ad creative" OR "marketing creatives") AND (conversion OR persuasion OR click-through OR sales)
queries.rationale: Surfaces research on what kinds of advertising content and creative choices drive response, persuasion, and downstream sales.

queries.query: (copywriting OR "message framing" OR "marketing message" OR tagline) AND (advertising OR promotion OR conversion OR persuasion)
queries.rationale: Covers the language and framing choices in marketing messages that influence response and conversion.

queries.query: ("product name" OR "brand name" OR naming) AND (choice OR preference OR sales OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Targets research on how names affect memorability, preference, evaluation, and purchase outcomes relevant to DTC product launches.

queries.query: (scarcity OR urgency OR "limited time" OR "limited quantity") AND (purchase OR conversion OR checkout OR demand)
queries.rationale: Finds evidence on whether scarcity and urgency messaging increases conversions and under what conditions it backfires.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR popularity OR ratings OR reviews) AND (conversion OR purchase OR choice OR sales)
queries.rationale: Captures studies on ratings, reviews, and popularity cues that influence online choice and conversion behavior.

queries.query: (nudge OR nudging OR "choice architecture" OR default) AND (purchase OR conversion OR consumer OR checkout)
queries.rationale: Targets lightweight intervention studies on defaults, ordering, and behavioral nudges that affect purchase and checkout decisions.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "website design" OR "online retail" OR ecommerce) AND (conversion OR experiment OR "A/B test" OR click-through)
queries.rationale: Focuses on evidence from online retail and website experiments directly relevant to conversion optimization.

queries.query: (personalization OR targeting OR recommendation) AND (advertising OR ecommerce OR conversion OR sales)
queries.rationale: Finds research on when tailored messages or recommendations improve performance versus create fatigue or privacy concerns.

queries.query: ("price promotion" OR markdown OR coupon OR rebate) AND (elasticity OR demand OR sales OR profitability)
queries.rationale: Surfaces quantitatively grounded work on promo lift, demand response, and whether promotions are profitable rather than merely attention-getting.

queries.query: ("willingness to pay" OR "reservation price" OR "price sensitivity") AND (consumer OR product OR brand OR promotion)
queries.angle: price sensitivity and willingness to pay
queries.rationale: Captures studies explaining why some pricing and promotional tactics work through changes in perceived value and price sensitivity.

queries.query: ("field experiment" OR "randomized experiment" OR "A/B test") AND (marketing OR advertising OR pricing OR promotion)
queries.rationale: Prioritizes papers with stronger causal designs that a practitioner can trust more than correlational trend pieces.

queries.query: ("consumer behavior" OR shopper OR purchase) AND (checkout OR cart OR "point of purchase" OR "purchase decision")
queries.rationale: Finds work on the final-stage decision environment where friction, cues, and presentation can change conversion.

queries.query: ("choice overload" OR assortment OR option) AND (conversion OR purchase OR choice OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on whether more options help or hurt conversion and decision quality in online shopping contexts.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan emphasizes actionable, empirical angles for a growth marketer: pricing and promotions, ad and message effectiveness, naming, social proof, scarcity, nudges, landing page conversion, and experimental evidence. It deliberately avoids advertising history, media studies, and high-theory consumer research unless those studies are tied to purchase, sales, or conversion outcomes. The profile assumption driving the plan is that the reader wants fast access to causal or quantitative findings that can inform tests in e-commerce and DTC settings.
